classification_rules.fsbo_candidate: INDIZIO_PRIVATO or other weak seller hints generate VERIFY, not CALL, until evidence is sufficient.
classification_rules.expired: Use INCARICO_SCADUTO only with explicit evidence; otherwise POSSIBILE_SCADUTO, RITIRATO_DAL_MERCATO, NON_PIU_RILEVATO, CAMBIO_AGENZIA or DA_VERIFICARE.
classification_rules.sold: Never infer VENDUTO only from disappearance. Default disappearance state is NON_PIU_RILEVATO until verified.
classification_rules.ownership: Never infer a named owner only from address, street, civic number or nearby directory contact.
classification_rules.contact: A CALL task never bypasses do_not_contact, RPO or other applicable contact checks.
